Here are the 15 newest hoodie ads in the GetHookd library. All of them are active apparel ads that started running yesterday, Oct 30, 2026.

| Brand | Headline | Hook / offer | Format |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bright Craft | Save 30% on the hoodie everyone is talking about | 60-day risk-free trial | Image |
| Blue Supply | Why thousands switched to this hoodie | Free shipping over $100, 90-day trial | Image |
| Blue Supply | Save 30% on the hoodie everyone is talking about | Handmade materials, limited stock | Image |
| Vivid Goods | Meet the hoodie customers keep buying | 4.2★ from 8,033 reviews, limited stock | Image |
| Nova Bloom | Eco-friendly hoodie for gift season | Limited stock, 30-day trial | Carousel |
| Golden Nest | Save 35% on the hoodie everyone is talking about | "For every budget," 60-day trial | Video |
| Vivid Nest | The hoodie you will actually use | Lightweight, "for busy mornings" | Image |
| Kind Studio | Our premium hoodie just dropped | Free shipping over $50, limited stock | Carousel |
| Kind Studio | Meet the hoodie customers keep buying | Eco-friendly materials, satisfaction guarantee | Image |
| Green Club | Our premium hoodie just dropped | Free shipping over $70 | Video |
| Green Club | The hoodie you will actually use | Free shipping over $90 | Carousel |
| Bright Nest | Our bestselling hoodie just dropped | 5★ from 659 reviews, limited stock | Image |
| True Supply | Save 40% on the hoodie everyone is talking about | Free shipping over $50, limited stock | Carousel |
| Urban Studio | Our award-winning hoodie just dropped | 4.2★ from 11,955 reviews | Video |
| Little Craft | Our vegan hoodie just dropped | 4★ from 18,056 reviews, limited stock | Video |

**Patterns across these ads:**
- **Headlines:** Almost all use one of four templates: "Save X% on the hoodie everyone is talking about," "Our [adjective] hoodie just dropped," "Meet the hoodie customers keep buying," and "The hoodie you will actually use."
- **Urgency and reassurance:** Most pair "limited stock, order today" with a risk-free trial or free shipping above a minimum order.
- **Cross-sell:** Every ad ends by suggesting a second item, such as chinos, a jacket, sneakers or a t-shirt.
- **Format:** Image is the most common format (7), then carousel (4) and video (4).

The library has no spend or reach data, and impression rank only compares ads within the same brand, so I can't say which of these is performing best.

These ads all started on the same day, so the list only covers the last couple of days. I can show more results, narrow the list by format or offer, or pull the full copy and target countries for any ad.
